title: 10 Lies Porn Tells a Man Who Wants to Be Godly
caption:
Porn doesn't just tempt you. It talks. And most of what it says sounds reasonable at 11 PM.

Read these slowly. If you've believed one, you're not the only one, and none of them hold up.

Save this and send it to a brother who needs the truth back.
